items.title: The Shawshank Redemption

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Morgan Freeman

items.plot: A banker sentenced to life for murders he insists he didn't commit enters Shawshank prison. Over two decades he befriends a long-serving inmate, quietly reshapes prison life, and holds on to hope.

items.title: The Godfather

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Marlon Brando
nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — James Caan
Actor in a Supporting Role — Robert Duvall
Actor in a Supporting Role — Al Pacino

items.plot: Aging Mafia don Vito Corleone rules a powerful New York crime family. When he refuses to back a narcotics deal and is targeted, his reluctant youngest son Michael is drawn into the family business and changes in ways no one expected.

items.title: The Dark Knight

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Heath Ledger

items.plot: Batman, Lieutenant Gordon and idealistic District Attorney Harvey Dent are close to breaking Gotham's mob. Then the Joker, a chaotic criminal, starts a campaign of terror meant to show that anyone can be corrupted, and Batman's moral code is pushed to its limit.

items.title: The Godfather Part II

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Robert De Niro
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Al Pacino
Actor in a Supporting Role — Michael V. Gazzo
Actor in a Supporting Role — Lee Strasberg
Actress in a Supporting Role — Talia Shire

items.plot: Two stories intertwine: young Vito Corleone flees Sicily and rises in New York's Little Italy in the early 1900s, while decades later his son Michael widens the family's empire to Nevada and Havana, at a steep cost to everyone close to him.

setting.place: Sicily; New York; Lake Tahoe; Havana

items.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
items.plot: Sauron's armies besiege Minas Tirith, and Gandalf and Aragorn rally the free peoples for a last stand. Meanwhile Frodo and Sam, worn down and betrayed by their guide, struggle up Mount Doom to destroy the Ring.

items.title: 12 Angry Men
items.plot: Twelve jurors retire to a sweltering room to decide whether a teenager is guilty of murdering his father. Eleven want a quick conviction, but one man's doubts force them to re-examine the evidence and their own prejudices.

items.title: Schindler's List

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Liam Neeson
Actor in a Supporting Role — Ralph Fiennes

items.plot: In occupied Poland, opportunistic German businessman Oskar Schindler profits from cheap Jewish labor. As he witnesses Nazi atrocities, he risks his fortune and his life to save more than a thousand of his workers.

items.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Ian McKellen

items.plot: The humble hobbit Frodo inherits a ring of terrible power that its dark lord creator wants back. Joined by a wizard, men, an elf, a dwarf and fellow hobbits, he sets out across Middle-earth to destroy it, pursued all the way by the enemy's servants.

items.title: Pulp Fiction

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — John Travolta
Actor in a Supporting Role — Samuel L. Jackson
Actress in a Supporting Role — Uma Thurman

items.plot: Told out of order, interlocking stories follow two philosophical hitmen, a boxer who double-crosses a crime boss, the boss's restless wife, and a pair of diner robbers. Their paths cross in violent, darkly funny ways across Los Angeles.

items.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
items.plot: With the Fellowship scattered, Frodo and Sam push on toward Mordor, guided by the treacherous Gollum. Meanwhile Aragorn, Legolas and Gimli help the kingdom of Rohan prepare to face Saruman's vast army at Helm's Deep.

items.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
items.plot: During the American Civil War, three gunmen compete to find a cache of Confederate gold buried in a remote cemetery. They are a quiet bounty hunter, a ruthless mercenary and a scheming bandit, and each knows only part of the secret.

setting.place: New Mexico and the American Southwest

items.title: Forrest Gump

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Tom Hanks
nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Gary Sinise

items.plot: Sitting at a bus stop, a kind-hearted Alabama man with a low IQ recounts his remarkable life. He stumbles through decades of American history, from Vietnam to ping-pong diplomacy, while never giving up on his childhood love.

setting.place: Alabama, across the USA and Vietnam

items.title: Fight Club
items.plot: A worn-out office worker with insomnia meets Tyler Durden, a charismatic soap salesman. Together they start an underground bare-knuckle fighting club as a release from consumer culture. The club grows into something much bigger and more dangerous than either man planned.

items.title: Inception
items.plot: A thief who steals secrets by entering people's dreams is offered a chance to clear his record. The job runs the other way: plant an idea in a powerful heir's mind. Haunted by his own past, he leads a team through layered dreams where time stretches and the danger is real.

setting.place: Paris, Mombasa, Los Angeles and dream worlds

items.title: Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back
items.plot: After the Empire smashes the Rebels' hidden base on the ice planet Hoth, Luke Skywalker seeks out Jedi Master Yoda for training. Meanwhile, Han Solo and Princess Leia are relentlessly pursued by Darth Vader across the galaxy.

setting.place: A galaxy far, far away (Hoth, Dagobah, Cloud City)

items.title: The Matrix
items.plot: Thomas Anderson is a programmer by day and a hacker called Neo by night. A mysterious group led by Morpheus contacts him and shows him that the world he knows is a computer simulation that keeps humanity captive. He is drawn into a rebellion against the machines that run it.

setting.place: The Matrix's virtual city and a ruined real Earth

items.title: Interstellar
items.plot: Blight and dust storms are slowly starving the Earth. A former NASA pilot leaves his children to lead a crew through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity, and he struggles against time and relativity to get back to them.

items.title: GoodFellas

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Joe Pesci
nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Lorraine Bracco

items.plot: Henry Hill grows up dreaming of being a gangster and rises through a Brooklyn mob crew alongside a volatile hothead and a calculating hijacker. The good life of money and respect eventually curdles into paranoia, drugs and betrayal.

items.title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Jack Nicholson
Actress in a Leading Role — Louise Fletcher
nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Brad Dourif

items.plot: Small-time con man R.P. McMurphy fakes insanity to dodge prison work and lands in a state mental hospital. His rebellious energy wakes up the cowed patients and brings him into a battle of wills with the icily controlling Nurse Ratched.
items.source: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest

items.title: Seven
items.plot: In a grim, rain-soaked city, a weary detective on the verge of retirement partners with a brash newcomer. They hunt a meticulous serial killer whose murders are each modeled on one of the seven deadly sins.

items.title: It's a Wonderful Life

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — James Stewart

items.plot: A kind small-town banker, who has sacrificed his own dreams to help his neighbors, reaches despair on Christmas Eve. A guardian angel is sent to show him what his town would look like if he had never been born.

items.title: The Silence of the Lambs

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Anthony Hopkins
Actress in a Leading Role — Jodie Foster

items.plot: An FBI trainee is sent to interview Hannibal Lecter, a brilliant psychiatrist and imprisoned cannibal, hoping he can help catch a serial killer who skins his victims. Lecter trades insight for pieces of her past.

items.title: Saving Private Ryan

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Tom Hanks

items.plot: After the D-Day landings, an Army captain takes a small squad deep into Normandy to find one paratrooper whose three brothers have all been killed. The War Department wants him sent home, and his men start to wonder whether one life is worth risking eight.

items.title: Seven Samurai
items.plot: Facing another raid by bandits at harvest time, poor farmers in a mountain village hire a handful of masterless samurai, paid only in rice. An experienced leader assembles the team and trains the villagers to defend themselves.

items.title: The Green Mile

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Michael Clarke Duncan

items.plot: In 1935 the head guard on a Louisiana death row meets a new inmate, John Coffey, a gentle giant convicted of murdering two girls. Coffey turns out to have an extraordinary gift for healing, and the guards begin to doubt both his guilt and the justice of what they have been ordered to do.

items.title: City of God
items.plot: Rocket is a boy from a violent Rio de Janeiro housing project who hopes to become a photographer. Over two decades he watches his childhood friends grow into drug lords and soldiers in gang wars, which leads to an all-out battle for control of the neighbourhood.

setting.place: Cidade de Deus, Rio de Janeiro

items.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
items.plot: A reprogrammed Terminator is sent back to protect young John Connor from a far more advanced shape-shifting assassin. With his mother Sarah, they try to stop the creation of the machines that will start a nuclear war.

items.title: Back to the Future
items.plot: A teenager is accidentally sent thirty years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean built by his eccentric scientist friend. Stuck in 1955, he disrupts his parents' first meeting and must fix it before he erases himself.

items.title: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
items.plot: Tarantino's combined cut of both Kill Bill films tells the Bride's revenge as one continuous epic. Betrayed and left for dead at her wedding rehearsal, she works through her former assassin colleagues on her way to Bill. This version adds a longer, fully animated anime sequence.
items.source: Kill Bill: Vol. 1 and Kill Bill: Vol. 2

items.title: Spirited Away
items.plot: While moving house, ten-year-old Chihiro wanders with her parents into an abandoned theme park that turns out to be a resort for spirits. Her parents are turned into pigs, and she must work in a witch's bathhouse to find a way to free them and return home.

setting.place: Japan and a spirit world bathhouse

items.title: Gladiator

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Russell Crowe
nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Joaquin Phoenix

items.plot: Maximus is a trusted Roman general. When the emperor's jealous son seizes the throne, Maximus is betrayed and his family is murdered. He is sold into slavery and becomes a famous gladiator, then fights his way to the Colosseum in Rome to take revenge.

items.title: The Pianist

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Adrien Brody

items.plot: Władysław Szpilman is a celebrated Jewish pianist in Warsaw. When the Nazis occupy Poland, he escapes deportation, unlike his family, and survives the war in hiding in the ruined city, close to starvation and dependent on strangers, including one unexpected protector.

items.title: Grave of the Fireflies
items.plot: After American firebombing destroys their home in Kobe, a teenage boy and his little sister are left to fend for themselves. Unwelcome with relatives, they try to survive alone as wartime hunger closes in.

items.title: Harakiri
items.plot: An aging masterless samurai asks to commit ritual suicide in the courtyard of a powerful clan's estate. Before he does, he tells them the story of his son-in-law, which leads to a quiet indictment of samurai honor and hypocrisy.

items.title: Psycho

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Janet Leigh

items.plot: A Phoenix office worker steals a large sum of cash from her employer and flees, stopping for the night at an isolated motel run by a shy young man and his domineering mother. What happens there sets off a search by her sister and her lover.

items.title: The Lion King
items.plot: A lion cub destined to rule the Pride Lands flees into exile after his scheming uncle engineers his father's death. Grown up and carefree, he must decide whether to return and claim his place.

items.title: The Departed

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Mark Wahlberg

items.plot: A young Boston cop goes undercover inside Irish mob boss Frank Costello's crew, while Costello's own protégé rises through the state police as his mole. Each side learns there is a rat, and the two men race to find each other first.

items.title: Whiplash

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — J.K. Simmons

items.plot: An ambitious young drummer at an elite New York music conservatory is chosen for the top jazz band. Its abusive, perfectionist conductor pushes him well past his limits in the pursuit of greatness.

items.title: The Prestige
items.plot: Two stage magicians in Victorian London start as partners and become bitter rivals after a tragedy. Each becomes obsessed with beating the other's greatest illusion, and their feud grows into sabotage, deception and a dangerous experiment with science.

items.title: American History X

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Edward Norton

items.plot: A former neo-Nazi leaves prison transformed and tries to keep his younger brother from following his path. Through black-and-white flashbacks, the film reveals how his hatred took root and the crime that put him away.

items.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
items.plot: Miles Morales reunites with Gwen Stacy and is pulled across the multiverse. There he meets a society of Spider-People sworn to protect the fabric of reality. When they disagree about how to handle a new threat, Miles has to decide what being a hero means to him.

items.title: Léon: The Professional
items.plot: A solitary hitman in New York reluctantly takes in a 12-year-old neighbor after her family is murdered by a corrupt DEA agent. She asks him to teach her his trade so she can take revenge.

items.title: Cinema Paradiso
items.plot: A successful film director learns that the old projectionist of his Sicilian hometown has died. He remembers growing up in the village cinema, where the projectionist became his mentor and passed on a lifelong love of movies.

items.title: Casablanca

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Humphrey Bogart
Actor in a Supporting Role — Claude Rains

items.plot: In wartime Casablanca, cynical nightclub owner Rick Blaine shelters his heart and stays neutral. Then his former lover walks in with her husband, a resistance leader who needs letters of transit to escape, and Rick must choose between love and doing the right thing.

items.title: The Intouchables
items.plot: A wealthy Parisian aristocrat left quadriplegic by a paragliding accident hires a brash young man from the housing projects as his live-in caregiver. The man has no experience, but his irreverence brings joy back into both their lives.
items.source: Le Second Souffle (Philippe Pozzo di Borgo)

items.title: The Usual Suspects

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Kevin Spacey

items.plot: The lone talkative survivor of a deadly harbor explosion tells a customs agent how five criminals met in a police lineup. His story points to a legendary, possibly mythical crime lord known as Keyser Söze.

setting.place: Los Angeles and New York City

items.title: Django Unchained

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Christoph Waltz

items.plot: Two years before the Civil War, a German bounty hunter frees an enslaved man to help him track down a gang of outlaws. Their partnership turns into a mission to rescue the man's wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.

items.title: Alien
items.plot: The crew of the commercial towing ship Nostromo is woken early to investigate a signal from a desolate moon. They bring something back on board, and a deadly creature begins hunting them through the ship's dark corridors.

items.title: Rear Window
items.plot: Stuck in his apartment with a broken leg, a news photographer passes the time watching his neighbors across the courtyard. When one of them behaves strangely after his wife vanishes, he and his girlfriend begin to suspect murder.

items.title: Modern Times
items.plot: A factory worker driven to a breakdown by the assembly line drifts in and out of jobs and jail during the Depression. He teams up with a spirited orphan girl, and the two keep chasing a home and a decent life in a mechanized world.

items.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
items.plot: As the railroad pushes west, a widow arrives at her frontier homestead to find her new family murdered. A ruthless gunman working for a railroad baron wants her land, while a harmonica-playing stranger and a wanted outlaw circle the conflict for reasons of their own.

items.title: City Lights
items.plot: The Little Tramp falls for a blind flower seller who mistakes him for a wealthy man. His on-again, off-again friendship with a drunken millionaire gives him a chance to pay for the operation that could restore her sight.

items.title: WALL·E
items.plot: Centuries after humans left a trash-covered Earth, WALL·E is a lonely little robot who keeps cleaning up and collecting treasures. When a sleek probe named EVE arrives, he follows her into space on an adventure that could decide whether humanity ever comes home.

setting.place: Abandoned Earth and the starliner Axiom

items.title: Apocalypse Now

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Robert Duvall

items.plot: During the Vietnam War, Army Captain Willard is sent upriver into Cambodia to find and kill Colonel Kurtz, a decorated officer who has gone rogue and set himself up as a god. The journey grows stranger and more nightmarish with every bend in the river.

items.title: The Odyssey
items.plot: After the Trojan War, Odysseus, king of Ithaca, spends years trying to get home and faces monsters, gods and temptations along the way. Meanwhile his wife Penelope holds off suitors who want his throne, and his son Telemachus sets out to find him. Christopher Nolan's take on Homer's epic.

items.title: Memento
items.plot: Leonard cannot form new memories, yet he is hunting the man who attacked his wife, relying on Polaroids, notes and tattoos. The story runs in reverse, scene by scene, so the audience shares his confusion about whom he can trust.

items.title: Avengers: Infinity War
items.plot: The Titan Thanos sets out to collect all six Infinity Stones so he can wipe out half of all life in the universe. Earth's heroes, scattered and divided, join forces with the Guardians of the Galaxy to try to stop him.

setting.place: New York, Wakanda, Scotland and outer space

items.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
items.plot: In 1936, archaeologist and adventurer Indiana Jones is hired by U.S. intelligence to find the Ark of the Covenant before the Nazis can use its power. The chase takes him from Nepal to Egypt with his tough former flame Marion.

items.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
items.plot: Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales gets spider powers just as a collider tears open the multiverse. Spider-people from other realities land in his city, and Miles has to learn to be a hero in his own way before the damage becomes permanent.

items.title: The Lives of Others
items.plot: In 1984 East Berlin, Stasi captain Wiesler is ordered to spy on a celebrated playwright and his actress partner. As he listens to their lives through hidden microphones, the loyal agent finds his own beliefs and loyalties shifting.

items.title: Witness for the Prosecution

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Charles Laughton
Actress in a Supporting Role — Elsa Lanchester

items.plot: A famous London barrister in poor health takes on a charming man accused of murdering a rich widow. The case seems to depend on the testimony of the defendant's cool, foreign-born wife, whose behavior in court shocks everyone.

items.title: Paths of Glory
items.plot: During World War I, an ambitious French general orders his exhausted troops into a hopeless assault on a German stronghold. When it fails, three soldiers are picked to stand trial for cowardice, and their colonel tries to defend them.

items.title: The Shining
items.plot: Struggling writer Jack Torrance takes a job as winter caretaker of an isolated Colorado mountain hotel and brings his wife and young son. As snow traps them, the hotel's dark presence works on Jack, while his psychic son sees terrible visions.

items.title: Inglourious Basterds

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Christoph Waltz

items.plot: In Nazi-occupied France, a squad of Jewish-American soldiers led by a hillbilly lieutenant spreads terror among German troops. At the same time, a young Jewish cinema owner who survived a massacre plots revenge as the Nazi elite gather at her theatre for a film premiere.

items.title: The Great Dictator

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Charles Chaplin
Actor in a Supporting Role — Jack Oakie

items.plot: A Jewish barber with amnesia returns to his ghetto in Tomainia, now ruled by a ranting dictator who happens to look just like him. Satire of fascism mixes with slapstick as the two men's paths converge.

items.title: Aliens

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Sigourney Weaver

items.plot: Decades after her first encounter with the creature, Ellen Ripley is rescued and persuaded to return to the planet where it was found, now home to a colony that has gone silent. She accompanies a squad of colonial marines who badly underestimate what awaits.

items.title: 12th Fail
items.plot: Manoj, a poor village boy from the Chambal region, fails school after his exam hall is stopped from cheating. He moves to Delhi to prepare for India's very hard civil-service exam and keeps trying through poverty, menial jobs and repeated failures, holding on to his determination and his integrity.

items.title: High and Low
items.plot: A wealthy shoe executive in Yokohama, about to risk everything on a takeover, learns his son has been kidnapped. Then it turns out the kidnapper took his chauffeur's boy by mistake, and the executive must decide whether to pay the ransom anyway.

items.title: Avengers: Endgame
items.plot: Five years after Thanos wiped out half of all life, the surviving Avengers are still grieving. A chance at reversing the disaster leads them to try a dangerous plan through time, which builds to a final battle for the universe.

setting.period: Contemporary to near future, with time travel

items.title: Good Will Hunting

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Robin Williams
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Matt Damon
Actress in a Supporting Role — Minnie Driver

items.plot: A janitor at MIT secretly solves a math problem that baffles the students, revealing a rare genius. Facing jail after a fight, he is ordered into therapy with a grieving community-college psychologist who finally gets through to him.

items.title: Coco
items.plot: A Mexican boy dreams of being a musician even though his family bans music. On the Day of the Dead he is magically transported to the Land of the Dead, where he searches for his idolized great-great-grandfather and uncovers his family's true history.

setting.place: Santa Cecilia, Mexico; Land of the Dead

items.title: Toy Story

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

items.plot: A pull-string cowboy doll is a boy's favorite toy until a flashy new space ranger action figure arrives. Their rivalry gets both of them lost in the outside world, and they must cooperate to get home before the family moves.

items.title: The Dark Knight Rises
items.plot: Eight years after taking the blame for Harvey Dent's crimes, a reclusive Bruce Wayne comes back as Batman. A masked revolutionary named Bane seizes Gotham and threatens to destroy it, and a slippery cat burglar complicates his task.

items.title: Amadeus

won: Actor in a Leading Role — F. Murray Abraham
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Tom Hulce

items.plot: Aged and broken, court composer Antonio Salieri confesses to a priest his lifelong envy of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, a vulgar, giggling prodigy whose music he recognized as divine. In flashbacks, Salieri describes how he set out to destroy his rival.

items.title: Your Name.
items.plot: A Tokyo boy and a girl from a rural mountain town begin waking up in each other's bodies. They communicate through notes and phone memos, and their connection draws them toward each other just as a celestial event threatens her town.

items.title: 3 Idiots
items.plot: Two friends set off across India to find Rancho, their college roommate who vanished years before. Rancho was a free-thinking genius who defied a rote-learning engineering school and its dictatorial director. As they remember him, they rethink success, friendship and pressure from family.

items.title: Das Boot
items.plot: In autumn 1941, a German U-boat sets out from occupied France to hunt Allied convoys in the Atlantic. Crammed into the cramped steel hull, the young crew swings between boredom and terror as they endure depth-charge attacks and a dangerous mission.

setting.place: Atlantic Ocean; La Rochelle; Strait of Gibraltar

items.title: Braveheart
items.plot: After English soldiers murder his wife, Scottish commoner William Wallace leads a rebellion against King Edward I. His victories turn him into a national hero, while Scottish nobles waver between loyalty and self-interest.

items.title: Princess Mononoke
items.plot: Cursed by a demonic boar, a young prince travels west seeking a cure. He becomes caught in a war between a mining town clearing the forest and the animal gods who defend it, alongside a girl raised by wolves.

items.title: Oldboy
items.plot: Oh Dae-su, a drunk businessman, is kidnapped and kept in a private cell for fifteen years without ever learning why. When he is suddenly let go, he is given five days to find his jailer and work out the reason, and he discovers that his captor's game is far from finished.

items.title: Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Peter Sellers

items.plot: An unhinged U.S. Air Force general sends his bombers to make a nuclear attack on the Soviet Union. The President, his advisers and an odd weapons expert gather in the War Room and scramble to recall the planes before a doomsday device goes off.

setting.place: U.S. air base; the Pentagon War Room; a B-52 bomber

items.title: American Beauty

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Kevin Spacey
nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Annette Bening

items.plot: Lester Burnham is a suburban father in a midlife slump who suddenly rebels: he quits his job, works out and becomes infatuated with his teenage daughter's friend. As he unravels, his ambitious wife, his sullen daughter and their unusual new neighbours all face crises of their own.

items.title: Capernaum
items.plot: A streetwise 12-year-old boy in the Beirut slums sues his parents for bringing him into a life of neglect. The story moves back through how he ran away and ended up caring for the baby son of an Ethiopian migrant worker without papers.

items.title: Singin' in the Rain

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Jean Hagen
Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

items.plot: As talking pictures upend Hollywood, a silent-film star, his wisecracking pal and an aspiring young actress scramble to rescue a stiff costume drama by turning it into a musical. One obstacle remains: the leading lady's grating voice.

items.title: Once Upon a Time in America
items.plot: Decades after fleeing New York, an aging gangster returns to the Lower East Side and confronts memories of the friends he grew up with. Moving between boyhood, Prohibition-era bootlegging and the 1960s, the film traces loyalty, ambition and betrayal across a lifetime.

items.title: Joker

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Joaquin Phoenix

items.plot: Arthur Fleck, a mentally ill and isolated man who wants to be a stand-up comedian, is pushed further to the edge by a cruel and decaying Gotham City. His slide into violence turns him into an unlikely symbol of public anger.

items.title: Toy Story 3
items.plot: Andy is leaving for college, and his toys end up at a daycare center by mistake. It seems like a paradise at first, but a hidden tyranny runs the place, and Woody must lead a daring escape to get everyone home.

items.title: Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi
items.plot: Luke Skywalker and his friends rescue Han Solo from the gangster Jabba the Hutt, then join the Rebel Alliance's final attack on a new Death Star. While the rebels battle on the forest moon of Endor, Luke confronts Darth Vader and the Emperor.

setting.place: A galaxy far, far away (Tatooine, Endor)

items.title: Come and See
items.plot: An eager Belarusian boy joins the Soviet partisans during the German occupation. What follows is a harrowing journey through a countryside being systematically destroyed, as the war's atrocities strip away his youth.
items.source: Khatyn; I Am from the Fiery Village (Ales Adamovich)

items.title: Requiem for a Dream

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Ellen Burstyn

items.plot: A lonely Coney Island widow becomes hooked on diet pills while dreaming of being on TV. Her son, his girlfriend and his best friend chase a heroin-dealing scheme. Over three seasons, all four of them spiral into addiction and lose touch with reality.

items.title: Ikiru
items.plot: A long-serving Tokyo bureaucrat who has spent decades shuffling papers learns he has terminal stomach cancer. Shaken, he searches for meaning in nightlife and youth before resolving to accomplish one worthwhile thing with his remaining months.

items.title: Incendies
items.plot: After their mother dies, twins in Montreal are given letters to deliver to a father they thought was dead and a brother they never knew existed. Their search takes them to her war-torn Middle Eastern homeland and into her hidden past.

setting.place: Montreal; an unnamed Middle Eastern country

items.title: The Hunt
items.plot: A kind kindergarten teacher in a small Danish town is rebuilding his life after a divorce. A child's untrue remark sets off a wave of suspicion, and his friends and neighbors turn on him with frightening speed.

items.title: Attack on Titan: The Last Attack
items.plot: A theatrical cut of the final two episodes of the anime series. Eren Yeager has set off a catastrophe that threatens to wipe out the world, and his former friends join old enemies in a desperate attempt to stop him.
items.source: Attack on Titan (anime series, from Hajime Isayama's manga)

items.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Kate Winslet

items.plot: After a painful breakup, shy Joel learns that his ex-girlfriend Clementine has had all her memories of him erased, and he decides to undergo the same procedure. As the memories are wiped one by one inside his mind, he realises he wants to keep them.

items.title: The Apartment

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Jack Lemmon
Actor in a Supporting Role — Jack Kruschen
Actress in a Leading Role — Shirley MacLaine

items.plot: An ambitious insurance clerk climbs the corporate ladder by lending his apartment to executives for their affairs. He is smitten with the company's elevator operator, then learns she is involved with his boss.

items.title: Lawrence of Arabia

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Peter O'Toole
Actor in a Supporting Role — Omar Sharif

items.plot: An unconventional British officer is sent to Arabia during World War I to assess the revolt against the Ottoman Turks. He unites rival tribes in a desert campaign that makes him a legend, but the war changes him.

items.title: Heat
items.plot: A disciplined professional thief plans one last big score with his crew in Los Angeles. An obsessive police lieutenant whose personal life is falling apart closes in, and the two men develop a wary respect.

items.title: Scarface
items.plot: Tony Montana, a Cuban refugee arriving in 1980 Miami, claws his way up the cocaine trade with ruthless ambition. He builds a vast drug empire, but greed, paranoia and his own product start to bring it all down.

items.title: Reservoir Dogs
items.plot: A jewelry heist goes badly wrong, and the surviving criminals, known to each other only by color-coded aliases, regroup at a warehouse. Suspecting one of them is an undercover cop, they turn on each other.

items.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
items.plot: A mysterious black monolith appears at key moments in human history, from prehistoric apes to a lunar excavation. Years later, a crewed mission heads for Jupiter to find its source, but the ship's calm, all-seeing computer HAL 9000 has its own ideas.

setting.place: African savanna; the Moon; deep space near Jupiter

items.title: Up
items.plot: A grieving elderly widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and floats off to fulfil a promise to his late wife. He finds an overeager young Wilderness Explorer has come along, and together they head for a remote South American waterfall.

setting.place: US city; Paradise Falls, South America

items.title: Double Indemnity

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Barbara Stanwyck

items.plot: An insurance salesman falls for a married woman who wants her husband dead, and together they plot a murder dressed up as an accident to collect a double-indemnity payout. His sharp-eyed colleague, a claims investigator, starts to smell something wrong.

items.title: Like Stars on Earth
items.plot: Eight-year-old Ishaan is a dreamy boy who keeps failing at school, and his frustrated parents send him to a strict boarding school. A lively new art teacher sees that Ishaan is not lazy but dyslexic, and helps him find his confidence and his talent.

setting.place: Mumbai and a boarding school in Panchgani, India

items.title: North by Northwest
items.plot: A smooth Manhattan advertising executive is mistaken for a government agent and kidnapped by spies. Framed for murder, he flees across the country, pursued by both police and villains, and meets an alluring woman whose loyalty is unclear.

setting.place: New York City; Chicago; Mount Rushmore

items.title: Full Metal Jacket
items.plot: Marine recruits are broken down by a merciless drill instructor at boot camp, with devastating results for one struggling private. One of the recruits, now a military journalist, is then sent into the chaos of the Vietnam War during the Tet Offensive.

setting.place: Parris Island, South Carolina and Vietnam

items.title: I Swear
items.plot: As a teenager in the 1980s, John Davidson develops severe Tourette syndrome in a small Scottish town and faces ridicule and misunderstanding. Helped by a few unlikely allies, he builds a life of acceptance and becomes a campaigner for others with the condition.

items.title: A Separation
items.plot: A Tehran couple are separating because she wants to emigrate and he refuses to leave his father, who has Alzheimer's. He hires a caregiver, and an incident with her spirals into a legal and moral conflict where every side has a point.

items.title: M
items.plot: A German city panics as a serial killer of children stays one step ahead of the police. Because the police crackdown is hurting business, the city's criminal underworld starts its own hunt for the murderer.

items.title: Die Hard
items.plot: A New York cop visits his estranged wife at her company's Christmas party in a Los Angeles skyscraper just as armed thieves take the building. Barefoot and alone, he wages a one-man fight against them floor by floor.

items.title: Amélie
items.plot: Amélie is a shy, imaginative waitress in Montmartre who finds a long-lost box of childhood treasures. Returning it to its owner gives her a taste for quietly fixing other people's lives. When it comes to her own heart, though, she has to work up the nerve to act.

items.title: Vertigo
items.plot: A former San Francisco detective who quit the force because of his fear of heights is hired by an old friend to follow his wife, who seems to be possessed by the past. He becomes obsessed with her, and the obsession leads somewhere dark.

items.title: Citizen Kane

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Orson Welles

items.plot: When a powerful newspaper magnate dies uttering a single cryptic word, a reporter interviews those who knew him to uncover its meaning. Their memories piece together a life of ambition, wealth and loneliness from childhood poverty to vast empire.

items.title: To Kill a Mockingbird

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Gregory Peck
nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Mary Badham

items.plot: In a sleepy Alabama town during the Depression, a principled widowed lawyer defends a Black man falsely accused of raping a white woman. His young daughter and son see the town's prejudice and learn about courage, including with a reclusive neighbor.

items.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
items.plot: When his father, a scholar obsessed with the Holy Grail, vanishes while searching for it, Indiana Jones follows his trail. Father and son reunite and race the Nazis across Europe and the Middle East to find the legendary cup.

setting.place: Utah, Venice, Germany and the Middle East

items.title: The Sting

won: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Robert Redford

items.plot: After a mob boss has his partner killed, a young grifter teams up with a seasoned con man in Depression-era Chicago. Together they assemble a crew to pull off an elaborate scheme designed to fleece the gangster without him ever knowing.

items.title: A Clockwork Orange
items.plot: Alex, a teenage gang leader who loves Beethoven and violence, terrorizes a bleak future England until he is caught and imprisoned. He volunteers for an experimental conditioning treatment meant to cure him of violence, with disturbing results.

items.title: Metropolis
items.plot: In a towering future city, the privileged elite live above while workers toil in machines below. The son of the city's master falls for a saintly woman preaching to the laborers, just as an inventor creates a robot in her image.

In April 1917, two young British soldiers must cross enemy territory to deliver an order that will call off an attack. If the message does not arrive, 1,600 men will walk into a German trap. The film is staged to look like one continuous shot.

items.title: The Wolf of Wall Street

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Leonardo DiCaprio
Actor in a Supporting Role — Jonah Hill

items.plot: A young stockbroker founds a Long Island brokerage that makes a fortune pushing penny stocks. Fueled by greed, drugs and excess, his firm grows into a decadent empire built on securities fraud, drawing the attention of the FBI.

items.title: Snatch
items.plot: A stolen diamond passes through London's underworld while a small-time boxing promoter has to deal with a vicious gangster after his fighter is knocked out by an unbeatable Irish Traveller. Crooks, bookies and robbers keep colliding in a fast, comic chase for the stone.

items.title: The Truman Show

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Ed Harris

items.plot: Truman Burbank lives a cheerful, ordinary life in a seaside town, not knowing that he was born on camera and that everyone around him is an actor in a round-the-clock reality show. Strange glitches make him suspicious, and he becomes set on getting out.

setting.place: Seahaven, a giant TV studio town

items.title: Woman in the Dunes
items.plot: An amateur insect collector from Tokyo misses the last bus out of a seaside village and is offered a night's lodging with a widow living at the bottom of a sand pit. In the morning he finds he cannot climb out.

items.title: Downfall
items.plot: Through the eyes of his young secretary, the film follows Adolf Hitler and his inner circle in the Berlin bunker during the last days of World War II. As the Soviets close in, the regime collapses into delusion, despair and suicide.
items.source: Inside Hitler's Bunker / Until the Final Hour

items.title: Shutter Island
items.plot: Two US marshals come to a hospital for the criminally insane on a storm-battered island to look for a missing patient. The longer they stay, the more the staff's secrecy and the lead investigator's own traumas cloud what is really happening.

items.title: L.A. Confidential

won: Actress in a Supporting Role — Kim Basinger

items.plot: In 1950s Los Angeles, three very different cops, one ambitious, one violent and one celebrity-hungry, investigate a coffee shop massacre. Their cases lead into a web of police corruption, tabloid scandal and high-end prostitution.

items.title: Dangal
items.plot: A former national wrestling champion in rural Haryana never won gold for India. Defying village prejudice, he puts his daughters through a punishing training regime to turn them into world-class wrestlers.

items.title: Green Book

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Mahershala Ali
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Viggo Mortensen

items.plot: A rough Italian-American bouncer from the Bronx is hired to drive a refined Black classical pianist on a concert tour through the segregated Deep South. Over two months on the road, the two very different men become friends.

setting.place: New York and the American South

items.title: Bicycle Thieves
items.plot: In poverty-stricken postwar Rome, an unemployed man finally lands a job putting up posters, which requires a bicycle. When it is stolen on his first day, he and his young son search the city for it.

items.title: Judgment at Nuremberg

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Maximilian Schell
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Spencer Tracy
Actor in a Supporting Role — Montgomery Clift
Actress in a Supporting Role — Judy Garland

items.plot: In 1948 an American judge from a small town presides over the trial of four German judges accused of enforcing Nazi laws. While witnesses testify, he tries to understand how ordinary Germans let it happen, as Cold War politics pushes for leniency.

items.title: Jurassic Park
items.plot: A billionaire invites scientists to preview his island theme park of cloned dinosaurs before it opens. When a saboteur shuts down the security systems during a storm, the visitors must survive the animals now roaming free.

items.title: Batman Begins
items.plot: Haunted by his parents' murder, billionaire heir Bruce Wayne travels the world learning to fight from a shadowy league of assassins. He returns to corrupt Gotham City as a masked vigilante, just as a plot to spread terror threatens to destroy it.

items.title: For a Few Dollars More
items.plot: Two bounty hunters, a laconic young gunman and a veteran former colonel, are after the same vicious outlaw who is planning a bank robbery. They grudgingly team up, though the colonel has a personal reason for the hunt.

items.title: Hamilton
items.plot: A filmed stage performance of the original Broadway cast of the hip-hop musical about Alexander Hamilton. It follows the orphaned immigrant's rise to Founding Father, his rivalry with Aaron Burr, and the personal cost of his ambition.

setting.place: New York and the early United States

items.title: There Will Be Blood

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Daniel Day-Lewis

items.plot: Daniel Plainview is a ruthless silver miner turned oil man. He arrives in a small California town to buy up land on top of a vast oil field. His ambition and contempt for others lead to a long, bitter struggle with a young preacher who has ambitions of his own.

setting.place: New Mexico and California oil country

items.title: Some Like It Hot

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Jack Lemmon

items.plot: Two broke Chicago jazz musicians witness a gangland massacre and escape by dressing as women and joining an all-female band headed for Florida. One falls for the band's singer, while the other attracts an eager millionaire.

items.title: Taxi Driver

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Robert De Niro
Actress in a Supporting Role — Jodie Foster

items.plot: Travis Bickle, a lonely, insomniac Vietnam veteran, drives a night taxi through the seedy streets of New York. Disgusted by the city and rejected by a campaign worker he idolizes, he fixates on saving a teenage sex worker and begins arming himself.

items.title: The Father

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Anthony Hopkins
nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Olivia Colman

items.plot: Anthony, an elderly Londoner, refuses help from his daughter as his dementia gets worse. The film shows his confusion from the inside: faces, rooms and timelines keep shifting, so the viewer is as unsure as he is about what is real.

items.title: The Kid
items.plot: A poor tramp finds an abandoned baby and reluctantly raises him in the slums. Years later the pair work small scams together, until the authorities and the boy's now-successful mother threaten to pull them apart.

items.title: All About Eve

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — George Sanders
nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Anne Baxter
Actress in a Leading Role — Bette Davis
Actress in a Supporting Role — Celeste Holm
Actress in a Supporting Role — Thelma Ritter

items.plot: A starstruck young fan worms her way into the life of an aging Broadway star, becoming her devoted assistant. Behind the humble facade is a calculating ambition that threatens the actress's career, friendships and romance.

items.title: The Sixth Sense

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Haley Joel Osment
Actress in a Supporting Role — Toni Collette

items.plot: Malcolm Crowe is a child psychologist still shaken by a patient he failed. He takes on the case of Cole, a frightened, withdrawn boy in Philadelphia who says he sees dead people. As Malcolm tries to help, he has to decide whether the boy's visions are real.

items.title: Ran
items.plot: An aging warlord in feudal Japan divides his domain among his three sons and banishes the one who warns him against it. His decision unleashes rivalry, treachery and war that consume his family and his kingdom.

items.title: Casino

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Sharon Stone

items.plot: A meticulous handicapper is installed by the mob to run a Las Vegas casino. His marriage to a volatile hustler and his violent childhood friend's growing recklessness threaten to bring down the whole operation.
items.source: Casino: Love and Honor in Las Vegas

items.title: The Thing
items.plot: A research team at an isolated Antarctic station takes in a sled dog fleeing a Norwegian helicopter. The dog carries a shape-shifting alien that can perfectly imitate any living thing, and paranoia spreads as the men can't tell who is still human.

items.title: No Country for Old Men

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Javier Bardem
Directing — Joel Coen and Ethan Coen

items.plot: A Texas welder out hunting finds the aftermath of a drug deal gone wrong and walks away with two million dollars. A remorseless hitman starts tracking him, and an ageing sheriff follows the bloody trail, troubled by how violent the world has become.

setting.place: West Texas and the Mexican border

items.title: Prisoners
items.plot: Two young girls go missing on Thanksgiving in suburban Pennsylvania. The police release their only suspect for lack of evidence, and one girl's desperate father takes matters into his own hands while a dogged detective keeps working the case.

items.title: Top Gun: Maverick
items.plot: More than thirty years into his career, test pilot Pete "Maverick" Mitchell is called back to Top Gun to train elite young aviators for a near-impossible mission. One of them is the son of his late best friend, and Maverick has to face his past while flying.

items.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
items.plot: A former assassin known as the Bride wakes from a four-year coma after her old crew shot her at her wedding. She makes a list of everyone responsible and starts working through it, first in suburban California and then in Tokyo against a yakuza boss and her army.

items.title: Pan's Labyrinth
items.plot: In 1944 Spain, young Ofelia moves with her pregnant mother into the rural outpost of her new stepfather, a sadistic Francoist captain who is hunting rebels. A faun in an overgrown labyrinth tells her she is a lost princess and sets her three dangerous tasks.

items.title: Unforgiven

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Gene Hackman
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Clint Eastwood

items.plot: A retired outlaw turned struggling pig farmer takes one last bounty job to support his children. With his old partner and a brash young gunman, he heads to a town ruled by a brutal sheriff.

items.title: A Beautiful Mind

won: Actress in a Supporting Role — Jennifer Connelly
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Russell Crowe

items.plot: John Nash is a brilliant, socially awkward mathematician at Princeton. He makes a breakthrough in his field and is later drawn into secret code-breaking work for the government. As his mind begins to betray him, his wife stands by him through decades of struggle.

items.title: Project Hail Mary
items.plot: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up alone on a spaceship light-years from Earth with no memory of why he is there. Slowly he remembers that he is humanity's last hope against a threat that is dimming the Sun, and then he finds he is not alone after all.

setting.place: The Hail Mary spacecraft and the Tau Ceti system

items.title: Howl's Moving Castle
items.plot: Sophie is a modest young hatmaker whom a jealous witch curses into the body of an old woman. She finds her way to the walking castle of the vain, mysterious wizard Howl, who is secretly resisting a senseless war that is tearing their kingdom apart.

items.title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Walter Huston

items.plot: Two broke Americans in Mexico team up with a grizzled old prospector to search for gold in the remote mountains. When they strike it rich, greed and paranoia begin to poison the partnership, while bandits close in.
items.source: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre

items.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle
items.plot: Tanjiro and the Demon Slayer Corps are pulled into the Infinity Castle, the ever-shifting fortress of demon king Muzan. Separated in its maze, the slayers face the most powerful Upper Rank demons in fierce battles that open the story's final arc.

items.title: Finding Nemo
items.plot: Marlin is an anxious clownfish who has lost nearly all his family. When his only son, Nemo, is taken by a diver and ends up in a dentist's aquarium, Marlin crosses the ocean to rescue him, with Dory, a cheerful fish who can barely remember anything, at his side.

setting.place: Great Barrier Reef and Sydney, Australia

items.title: Klaus
items.plot: A spoiled postman-in-training is sent to a frozen, feuding island town at the edge of the world. There he teams up with a reclusive toymaker, and their partnership starts small acts of kindness that slowly change the town. An animated origin story for Santa Claus.

setting.place: Smeerensburg, a fictional town in the far north

items.title: Yojimbo
items.plot: A wandering, masterless samurai arrives in a town split between two rival gangs. Seeing a chance for profit and mischief, he hires himself out to both sides and plays them against each other.

items.title: The Elephant Man

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — John Hurt

items.plot: In Victorian London, surgeon Frederick Treves rescues John Merrick, a severely deformed man, from a freak show. As Merrick's intelligence and gentleness come to light, he becomes a society curiosity, while still struggling to be seen as a human being.
items.source: The Elephant Man and Other Reminiscences; The Elephant Man: A Study in Human Dignity

items.title: The Great Escape
items.plot: The Germans gather their most persistent escapees in a new high-security prisoner-of-war camp. The Allied officers there plan a mass breakout through three tunnels, which requires forgers, diggers, tailors and scroungers.

items.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
items.plot: King Arthur and his knights, galloping on foot to the sound of coconut shells, are sent by God to find the Holy Grail. Their absurd quest pits them against taunting Frenchmen, a killer rabbit and the Knights Who Say Ni.

items.title: Dial M for Murder
items.plot: A retired tennis player who married for money learns that his wife has been unfaithful and decides to have her killed without leaving a trace. He blackmails an old acquaintance into doing it, but the scheme goes wrong in an unexpected way.

items.title: The Secret in Their Eyes
items.plot: A retired Buenos Aires court investigator starts writing a novel about a rape and murder case from 1974 that he never put behind him. Going back over it reopens old wounds and his unspoken feelings for his former boss.

items.title: Gone with the Wind

won: Actress in a Leading Role — Vivien Leigh
Actress in a Supporting Role — Hattie McDaniel
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Clark Gable
Actress in a Supporting Role — Olivia de Havilland

items.plot: Headstrong Southern belle Scarlett O'Hara pines for a man she cannot have while the Civil War and Reconstruction destroy the world of Georgia plantations. Through ruin and hunger she fights to save her family land, entangled all the while with the roguish Rhett Butler.

items.title: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
items.plot: Four London pals pool their cash so one of them can play in a rigged card game with a ruthless porn baron. Left owing a fortune with a week to pay, they plan to rob the dangerous neighbours next door, which sets off a farcical chain of gangsters, stolen guns and stolen weed.

items.title: Chinatown

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Jack Nicholson
Actress in a Leading Role — Faye Dunaway

items.plot: Los Angeles private eye Jake Gittes takes what looks like a routine adultery case involving a city water official. The job pulls him into a web of murder, land grabs and family secrets centered on the man's enigmatic widow and her powerful father.

items.title: Catch Me If You Can

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Christopher Walken

items.plot: Frank Abagnale Jr. is a teenager who runs away from his broken home and becomes a gifted con artist, posing as a pilot, a doctor and a lawyer while forging millions in checks. A dogged FBI agent follows his trail across the country and around the world.

items.title: V for Vendetta
items.plot: In a near-future Britain ruled by a fascist regime, a young woman is rescued by V, a masked, poetic revolutionary who is waging a one-man campaign of sabotage. He plans to bring down the government by the next fifth of November.

items.title: The Best of Youth
items.plot: Two Roman brothers take very different paths after a summer trip in 1966. Nicola becomes a psychiatrist and Matteo joins the police. Their family's story across nearly four decades runs alongside Italy's floods, political violence, Mafia killings and social change.

items.title: Dead Poets Society

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Robin Williams

items.plot: At a strict, tradition-bound boys' prep school, a new English teacher urges his students to think for themselves and seize the day. Inspired, a group of them revives a secret poetry club, but their newfound freedom collides with parental and institutional expectations.

items.title: Inside Out
items.plot: Riley's family moves to San Francisco, and the 11-year-old is thrown off balance. Inside her mind, the personified emotions Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust struggle to guide her, until Joy and Sadness get lost far from headquarters.

items.title: Trainspotting
items.plot: A young heroin addict in Edinburgh tries to get clean while his circle of volatile, self-destructive friends pulls him back. Mixing dark comedy with grim consequences, the film follows his attempts to choose a different life.
studios: The Noel Gay Motion Picture Company

items.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Sam Rockwell
Actress in a Leading Role — Frances McDormand
nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Woody Harrelson

items.plot: Months after her daughter's murder goes unsolved, a grieving and furious mother rents three roadside billboards calling out the town's respected police chief. Her campaign sets off a bitter, escalating conflict with the local police, especially a volatile deputy.

items.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
items.plot: Harry, Ron and Hermione race to find and destroy the last pieces of Voldemort's soul. The hunt leads back to Hogwarts, where the war between the wizarding world's defenders and the Dark Lord's forces comes to its final battle.
items.source: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

items.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Alec Guinness
Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)
nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Sessue Hayakawa

items.plot: British prisoners of war in a Japanese jungle camp are forced to build a railway bridge. Their rigid colonel turns the job into a matter of pride, while an escaped American is sent back with a commando team to destroy it.
items.source: The Bridge over the River Kwai

items.title: Rashomon
items.plot: Sheltering from a downpour at a ruined city gate, a woodcutter and a priest recount a murder and an assault in the forest. Testimonies from a bandit, a wife and even the dead man's spirit contradict each other, leaving the truth elusive.

items.title: Barry Lyndon

won: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

items.plot: An ambitious Irish youth, forced to flee after a duel, drifts through the Seven Years' War as a soldier and spy before reinventing himself as a gambler. Marrying a rich widow brings him into English high society, but his ambitions slowly unravel.

items.title: The Wild Robot
items.plot: A service robot called Roz washes up on a remote, uninhabited island. To survive, she learns the ways of the wild animals there and ends up raising an orphaned gosling. Slowly she becomes part of the island's community.

items.title: Ben-Hur

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Charlton Heston
Actor in a Supporting Role — Hugh Griffith

items.plot: A Jewish prince in Roman-ruled Judea is betrayed by his childhood friend, now a Roman tribune, and sentenced to the galleys. He survives to seek revenge, which leads to a famous chariot race, while his path keeps crossing that of Jesus.
items.source: Ben-Hur: A Tale of the Christ

items.title: Warrior

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Nick Nolte

items.plot: Two estranged brothers enter the same high-stakes mixed martial arts tournament: an ex-Marine with a troubled past, and a schoolteacher about to lose his home. Their recovering alcoholic father tries to make amends with both.

items.title: Hacksaw Ridge

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Andrew Garfield

items.plot: A Seventh-day Adventist from Virginia enlists as an army medic in World War II but refuses to carry a weapon. Despised by his fellow soldiers, he proves himself in the bloody Battle of Okinawa by rescuing dozens of wounded men alone.

items.title: Fargo

won: Actress in a Leading Role — Frances McDormand
nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — William H. Macy

items.plot: A desperate Minneapolis car salesman hires two criminals to kidnap his own wife for ransom money from her wealthy father. The plan unravels into bloodshed, and a pregnant small-town police chief patiently follows the trail.

items.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
items.plot: In a desert wasteland, a rebel commander drives off with a tyrant's captive wives, and a haunted drifter is dragged along. A furious chase across the sands follows as the warlord's war-party pursues them.

items.title: Ratatouille
items.plot: Remy is a rat in Paris with a refined palate who dreams of becoming a chef. He teams up with a clumsy kitchen worker at a famous restaurant and secretly cooks through him by tugging his hair. Together they try to win over the city's most feared food critic.

items.title: Million Dollar Baby

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Morgan Freeman
Actress in a Leading Role — Hilary Swank
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Clint Eastwood

items.plot: Frankie Dunn is a gruff old boxing trainer. He reluctantly agrees to train Maggie, a determined waitress from a poor background, and she rises fast through the women's ranks. The bond between them becomes a family neither has had, until a devastating turn tests it.
items.source: Rope Burns: Stories from the Corner

items.title: Children of Heaven
items.plot: A boy from a poor Tehran family loses his little sister's only pair of shoes. Afraid to tell their struggling parents, the siblings share his sneakers in shifts, until he sees a chance to win new shoes in a race.
studios: Institute for the Intellectual Development of Children and Young Adults

items.title: My Neighbor Totoro
items.plot: Two young sisters move with their father to an old house in the countryside to be near their hospitalized mother. Exploring the woods, they befriend Totoro, a huge, gentle forest spirit who brings magic to their worried days.

items.title: Gran Torino
items.plot: Walt Kowalski is a widowed Korean War veteran in Detroit with a lot of bitterness. When the shy Hmong teenager next door tries to steal his prized Gran Torino as a gang initiation, Walt grudgingly starts protecting the boy and his family, and finds his own prejudices tested.

items.title: Raging Bull

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Robert De Niro
nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Joe Pesci
Actress in a Supporting Role — Cathy Moriarty

items.plot: Middleweight boxer Jake LaMotta fights his way to a world title, driven by jealousy and fury that are as fierce outside the ring as inside it. His violence and paranoia steadily destroy his relationships with his wife and his brother.

items.title: 12 Years a Slave

won: Actress in a Supporting Role — Lupita Nyong'o
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Chiwetel Ejiofor
Actor in a Supporting Role — Michael Fassbender

items.plot: Solomon Northup, a free Black violinist from New York, is kidnapped in 1841 and sold into slavery in Louisiana. For twelve years he endures cruel owners and tries to stay alive and keep his dignity while hoping to get back to his family.

items.title: How to Train Your Dragon
items.plot: On a Viking island where killing dragons is a rite of passage, the chief's awkward son secretly befriends an injured dragon instead. What he learns from it challenges everything his village believes.

items.title: Memories of Murder
items.plot: In rural South Korea in the late 1980s, two very different detectives, a brutish local cop and a methodical one from Seoul, hunt a serial killer of women. With few resources and their methods failing, the investigation slowly wears them down.

items.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
items.plot: In a fictional Central European country between the wars, the fastidious concierge of a grand mountain hotel takes a young lobby boy under his wing. When the concierge is framed for murder over a priceless painting, the two set off on a caper as fascism closes in.

items.title: Before Sunrise
items.plot: A young American and a French student meet on a train and impulsively get off together in Vienna. With only one night before his flight home, they wander the city talking about love, life and themselves.

items.title: Monsters, Inc.
items.plot: In a city of monsters powered by children's screams, the top scarer, Sulley, and his best friend Mike find that a human girl has slipped into their world. Hiding her from a panicked society, they uncover a plot inside their own company.

items.title: Blade Runner
items.plot: In a rain-soaked, neon-lit Los Angeles of 2019, burnt-out cop Rick Deckard is ordered to hunt down four replicants, bioengineered humanoids who escaped an off-world colony to find their creator. The job forces him to question what makes someone human.
items.source: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?

items.title: Gone Girl

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Rosamund Pike

items.plot: On his fifth wedding anniversary, a Missouri man's wife disappears. As police and a media frenzy focus on him, his odd behavior and the cracks in their marriage make everyone wonder whether he killed her.

items.title: Ford v Ferrari
items.plot: Car designer Carroll Shelby and hot-headed British driver Ken Miles are hired by Ford to build a race car that can beat Ferrari at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. They have to fight corporate interference as well as the laws of physics.

setting.place: Los Angeles, Detroit and Le Mans, France

items.title: Jaws
items.plot: A great white shark begins killing swimmers off a New England resort island just as the summer season starts. When the town refuses to close the beaches, the police chief, a marine biologist and a grizzled shark hunter head out to sea to stop it.

items.title: In the Name of the Father

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Daniel Day-Lewis
Actor in a Supporting Role — Pete Postlethwaite
Actress in a Supporting Role — Emma Thompson

items.plot: A petty thief from Belfast and his friends are coerced into confessing to an IRA pub bombing in England. His father is imprisoned with him, and together they endure years of injustice while a lawyer fights to expose the truth.

items.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
items.plot: After his secret identity is revealed to the world, Peter Parker asks Doctor Strange to make everyone forget. The spell goes wrong and pulls in villains from other universes, forcing Peter to face what it really costs to be Spider-Man.

items.title: Wild Tales
items.plot: Six darkly comic, unrelated stories show ordinary Argentines pushed to their breaking point. A plane full of strangers, a road-rage feud, a wedding gone wrong and other mishaps all spiral into revenge and chaos.

items.title: Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc
items.plot: Denji, a devil hunter with a chainsaw heart, falls hard for Reze, a charming girl he meets at a café. Their sweet summer romance hides a dangerous secret, and it leads to a violent showdown.

items.title: The Gold Rush
items.plot: A lone prospector heads into the frozen Yukon in search of gold, sharing a snowbound cabin with a desperate fellow miner. In a boomtown he falls for a dance-hall girl while hoping his luck will finally turn.

items.title: Sherlock Jr.
items.plot: A shy small-town projectionist who dreams of being a detective is framed for stealing a pocket watch by a romantic rival. Dozing off at work, he walks into the movie on screen and becomes a suave master sleuth.

items.title: Mary and Max
items.plot: A lonely eight-year-old girl in Melbourne picks a name from a phone book and starts writing to a middle-aged New Yorker with Asperger's. Their unlikely pen friendship spans two decades of letters, misunderstandings and quiet comfort.

items.title: A Silent Voice: The Movie
items.plot: A former grade-school bully has become isolated and full of regret. As a teenager he seeks out the deaf girl he once tormented and tries to make amends, facing his guilt, his old classmates and his own wish to disappear.

items.title: The Wages of Fear
items.plot: Stranded and broke in a squalid South American oil town, four desperate men accept a well-paid suicide job: driving two trucks loaded with nitroglycerin across hundreds of miles of terrible road to put out a blazing oil well.

items.title: The Deer Hunter

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Christopher Walken
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Robert De Niro
Actress in a Supporting Role — Meryl Streep

items.plot: Three steelworker friends from a Pennsylvania town celebrate a wedding and a last deer hunt before shipping out to Vietnam. The war brutalizes them, and the survivors return home changed, or fail to return at all.

items.title: Logan
items.plot: In 2029, with mutants nearly extinct, a weary, ailing Logan cares for a frail Charles Xavier near the Mexican border. When a young mutant girl with powers like his own shows up hunted by a ruthless corporation, he reluctantly protects her on a desperate journey north.

items.title: Rocky

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Sylvester Stallone
Actor in a Supporting Role — Burgess Meredith
Actor in a Supporting Role — Burt Young
Actress in a Leading Role — Talia Shire

items.plot: Rocky Balboa, a small-time Philadelphia boxer who collects debts for a loan shark, gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot at the heavyweight champion as a publicity stunt. With a shy pet-shop clerk at his side, he trains hard to prove he isn't just a bum.

items.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Johnny Depp

items.plot: Undead pirates kidnap a governor's daughter in the Caribbean, believing she holds the key to lifting their curse. A young blacksmith who loves her teams up with Captain Jack Sparrow, an eccentric rogue who wants his stolen ship back, to chase them down.

items.title: The General
items.plot: When Union spies steal his beloved locomotive during the Civil War, a Southern train engineer chases them deep into enemy territory. His single-handed pursuit also gives him a chance to win back the woman who rejected him.

items.title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — James Stewart
Actor in a Supporting Role — Harry Carey
Actor in a Supporting Role — Claude Rains
Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

items.plot: An idealistic scoutmaster is appointed to fill a vacant U.S. Senate seat by a political machine that expects him to be a harmless puppet. When he stumbles onto graft tied to his own bill, he takes a lonely stand on the Senate floor.

items.title: Tokyo Story
items.plot: An elderly couple travels from their small seaside town to visit their grown children in Tokyo, only to find them too busy to make room for them. Their widowed daughter-in-law turns out to be the one who shows them real kindness.

items.title: La haine
items.plot: Over one day after a night of riots in a Paris housing project, three young friends drift between boredom, anger and police harassment. One of them has found a lost police gun and vows to use it if their injured friend dies.

items.title: Spotlight

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Mark Ruffalo
Actress in a Supporting Role — Rachel McAdams

items.plot: In 2001 the Boston Globe's investigative team starts digging into claims that a local priest abused children. Their reporting uncovers decades of widespread abuse and a cover-up reaching to the top of the Catholic Archdiocese.

items.title: Maharaja
items.plot: Maharaja, a quiet barber in Chennai, goes to the police with an odd complaint: his "Lakshmi" has been stolen and he wants it back at any cost. The officers mock him, but his strange case sets off a nonlinear revenge thriller that slowly reveals what he is really after.

items.title: Jai Bhim
items.plot: After a tribal man disappears in police custody on a false theft charge, his pregnant wife asks a human-rights lawyer for help. The lawyer takes the case to the High Court and exposes caste prejudice and police brutality.

items.title: The Sound of Music

won: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)
nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Julie Andrews
Actress in a Supporting Role — Peggy Wood

items.plot: A free-spirited postulant from an Austrian abbey becomes governess to the seven children of a strict, widowed naval captain, and wins them over with music. Romance grows between her and the captain as Nazi Germany prepares to annex Austria.
writers: Howard Lindsay and Russel Crouse (musical book)

items.title: The Terminator
items.plot: A relentless cyborg assassin arrives from the future to kill a Los Angeles waitress whose unborn son will lead humanity's resistance against the machines. A soldier sent back after it is her only protection.

items.title: Wild Strawberries
items.plot: An aging, emotionally distant professor drives to a university town to receive an honorary degree, accompanied by his daughter-in-law. Along the way, encounters with strangers set off dreams and memories that make him look hard at his life.

items.title: On the Waterfront

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Marlon Brando
Actress in a Supporting Role — Eva Marie Saint
nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Lee J. Cobb
Actor in a Supporting Role — Karl Malden
Actor in a Supporting Role — Rod Steiger

items.plot: A washed-up boxer working the New Jersey docks runs errands for the corrupt union boss who controls the waterfront. After he unwittingly helps set up a killing, a crusading priest and the victim's sister push him toward a dangerous choice.

items.title: The Best Years of Our Lives

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Fredric March
Actor in a Supporting Role — Harold Russell

items.plot: Three World War II veterans, an Army sergeant, an Air Force captain and a sailor who lost his hands, return to the same Midwestern city. Each struggles to readjust to families, jobs and a country that has moved on without them.

items.title: The Third Man
items.plot: An American pulp novelist arrives in bombed-out, occupied Vienna to take a job with an old friend, only to learn the friend has just died. Doubtful about the circumstances of the death, he probes the city's black market and uncovers a dark truth.

items.title: The Big Lebowski
items.plot: The Dude is a laid-back LA slacker who gets mixed up with a millionaire who shares his name. Thugs ruin his rug, and he is then asked to deliver a kidnapping ransom. With his volatile bowling buddy Walter along, the job turns into a shaggy, absurd tangle of nihilists, artists and missing money.

items.title: The Incredibles
items.plot: Bob Parr is a former superhero forced into dull suburban life by a government ban, and he misses the glory days. When a mysterious offer pulls him back into action, his wife and super-powered kids have to join forces to save him and the world.

setting.place: Metroville and the island of Nomanisan

items.title: Before Sunset
items.plot: Nine years after one magical night in Vienna, Jesse is now a published author on a book tour in Paris, and there he runs into Céline again. With only an afternoon before his flight, they walk and talk through the city and face what might have been.

items.title: Hachi: A Dog's Tale
items.plot: A college professor in a small New England town takes in a lost Akita puppy he finds at the train station. The dog greets him there every evening, and stays loyal long after the professor no longer comes home. The film is based on a famous Japanese true story.

items.title: The Chaos Class Failed the Class
items.plot: The rowdy, prank-loving students of a Turkish private high school return for another year. A strict new teacher clashes with them, and a young literature teacher wins their affection, while the long-suffering vice principal Mahmut Hoca tries to keep order.

items.title: Room

won: Actress in a Leading Role — Brie Larson

items.plot: A five-year-old boy has spent his whole life in a small shed with his mother, who has been held captive there for seven years. A daring escape brings them into the outside world, where they face new difficulties.

items.title: The Exorcist

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Jason Miller
Actress in a Leading Role — Ellen Burstyn
Actress in a Supporting Role — Linda Blair

items.plot: When her twelve-year-old daughter Regan begins behaving violently and inexplicably, an actress in Georgetown exhausts every medical explanation. She turns to a troubled young priest, who calls in a veteran exorcist to confront what has taken hold of the girl.

items.title: Hotel Rwanda

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Don Cheadle
Actress in a Supporting Role — Sophie Okonedo

items.plot: During the 1994 Rwandan genocide, Paul Rusesabagina, the manager of a luxury hotel in Kigali, uses bribes, charm and every connection he has to shelter more than a thousand Tutsi and Hutu refugees while the world looks away.

items.title: The Seventh Seal
items.plot: Returning from the Crusades to a Sweden ravaged by plague, a weary knight meets Death and challenges him to a game of chess to buy time. As they play, he travels the countryside searching for some sign that life has meaning.

items.title: Platoon

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Tom Berenger
Actor in a Supporting Role — Willem Dafoe

items.plot: A young college dropout volunteers for combat in Vietnam and is thrown into an infantry platoon. He finds the unit split between two sergeants with opposing moral codes, and the war becomes a battle for his own soul.

items.title: The Iron Giant
items.plot: In a small Maine town during the Cold War, a lonely boy befriends a huge metal robot that fell from the sky and is learning about the world. While he tries to keep his new friend hidden, a paranoid government agent closes in, convinced the giant is a weapon.

items.title: Rush
items.plot: The 1976 Formula One season is the peak of the rivalry between James Hunt, a charismatic British playboy, and Niki Lauda, a methodical Austrian perfectionist. Their contest pushes both men to the edge after a horrific crash.

items.title: Stand by Me
items.plot: A writer recalls the summer he and three boyhood friends set off on foot along the railroad tracks to find the body of a missing boy. The two-day trek tests their friendship and exposes the troubles each carries from home.

items.title: The Wizard of Oz
items.plot: A Kansas farm girl is swept by a tornado into the magical land of Oz. Joined by a scarecrow, a tin man and a cowardly lion, she follows the yellow brick road toward the wizard who may be able to send her home, while a wicked witch pursues her.

items.title: The Battle of Algiers
items.plot: Shot in a documentary style, the film follows the National Liberation Front's urban campaign against French colonial rule in Algiers. A former petty criminal joins the insurgents as French paratroopers move in to break the resistance.
items.source: Souvenirs de la Bataille d'Alger (Saadi Yacef)

items.title: My Father and My Son
items.plot: Sadık defied his landowning father to become a leftist journalist in Istanbul. After the 1980 military coup leaves him broken and ill, he returns to the family farm in the Aegean countryside with his imaginative young son, hoping to make peace with the father he walked away from.

items.title: The Passion of Joan of Arc
items.plot: Captured and put on trial by English-aligned clergy, the young Joan of Arc faces hours of hostile questioning designed to make her recant. Shot in stark close-ups, the film follows her suffering and her faith to its conclusion.
items.source: Trial records of Joan of Arc

items.plot: A travel photographer goes to his school reunion 22 years after graduating and meets his teenage sweetheart again, now visiting from Singapore. Over a single night in Chennai they revisit what they felt as teenagers, the misunderstanding that kept them apart, and what they still feel.

items.title: Autumn Sonata
items.plot: A celebrated concert pianist visits the daughter she hasn't seen in seven years at a rural Norwegian parsonage. Over one long night, years of buried resentment pour out as the daughter confronts her mother about a neglected childhood.

items.title: The Racket
